decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The floodlights shall not be used except through the control of an electronic timer to ensure that they operate during afternoon and evenings only and no later than 8.30pm and that the timer shall be kept permanently maintained to operate to this specification.

Condition : 4 - IlluminationBefore the lighting hereby approved is brought into use shall be adjusted and shielded so as not to cause lightspill into any nearby residential property and shall be maintained permanently in this state.
description: Retention of 4 no. floodlights located on corner posts to court
